rows.grounds: compound of the four aims of human life; taken as object
compound describing what is granted; agrees with object

items.question: Which four human aims and what enduring benefit are granted by this?
premises: The verse names duty, wealth, desire, and liberation as aims.
These four aims are presented as objects granted.
The granting is described as constant and happiness-bestowing.
items.inference: This grants the four aims of human life together with constant happiness.
items.plain_english: And it always grants duty, wealth, desire, liberation, and happiness.
